issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

disk.description: disk refers to RWO volume which is physically attached into K8s node, this is usually faster than nfs

nfs.description: nfs refers to RWX volume which is backed by managed Network Attached Storage (NAS ) to K8s node

title:
This is a mapping of storage label between c3 and k8s convention.
C3 users will use storageTypes categorized into disk (RWO) and nfs (RWX).
StorageClass corresponding to storageType will be provisioned to a c3Server, each K8s cluster will have
pre-configured storageClass created by cluster operator.
name: K8sStorageMappingConfig
